name: flowboard-rbac
description: FlowBoard — Project Tracker with Role-Based Access Control

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c teal,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c teal,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:push -w server && npm run seed -w server
